description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Earth], [Damage Cap +10000], [Our Bond Follow-Up] and [Mighty Severance] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Earth
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Our Bond Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Our Bond after using two Earth abilities

description.name: Mighty Severance
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth] after using four Earth abilities
